epic.summary: Regression fixture for to-issues #228 — v2.0 stories.json shape
epic.objective: Guard that to-issues reads the v2.0 schema (summary / description.* / storyPoints / labels[]) and applies the language-neutral informative-token module filter.

stories.summary: Wire the tenant probe endpoint and its harness

description.background: Operators need a single-tenant probe so we can validate the Brain-to-Body request path early and often. This story stands up the skeleton and nothing more.
description.scope: Build a FastAPI endpoint guarded by a harness hook; use python for the handler and bash for the smoke wrapper. Keep it bounded to one tenant.

successScenarios.title: Scenario 1: Probe answers
successScenarios.then: a 200 is returned with the tenant id
and: the harness hook recorded the call

definitionOfDone: Probe returns 200 for an authenticated single-tenant request
Harness hook logs each probe call

stories.summary: Persist probe results and expose a read model

description.background: Once the probe answers, results should be stored so operators can query history. This is a bounded read-and-write slice for privacy and confidentiality of stored records.
description.scope: Add a sql table for probe results and a read endpoint. Redact caller identity before write so the store holds no personal data.

successScenarios.title: Scenario 1: History persists
successScenarios.then: a redacted row appears in the read model

definitionOfDone: Probe results persist with caller identity redacted
Read endpoint returns stored results for the tenant
